component_strategies.header_nav: Sticky navbar with dark glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-950/80 border-b border-white/10), quick brand logo with glowing gradient emblem, sports search drawer, theme toggle switch, 'Create Card' primary CTA button
component_strategies.card_editor: Split layout on desktop (Left: Interactive Live Card Preview with 3D tilt effect on hover; Right: Tabbed editor for Sport, Template, Photo Upload & Adjustments, Player Details, Stats & Badges, Export options)
component_strategies.photo_crop_adjuster: Interactive canvas or container with Zoom slider, X/Y offset controls, Rotation, Contrast/Brightness filters, and background color remover option
component_strategies.png_export_engine: Uses html-to-image or html2canvas to render pixel-perfect high-resolution PNG outputs for 3:4 portrait collectible cards and 9:16 story format with instant download and Web Share API support
component_strategies.admin_dashboard: Sidebar layout with stats overview cards (Total Cards, Revenue, Active Users, Top Sports), Data Table for User Management with role badges and action menus, Subscription Grant modal, Sports Config JSON editor, Templates Admin toggle grid, System Audit Log feed with timestamped actions

general_ui_ux_guidelines.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive components, buttons, inputs, dropdowns, navigation links, card template selectors, export buttons, and admin rows MUST include clear data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='create-card-button', data-testid='template-select-black_gold_elite', data-testid='export-png-button').
general_ui_ux_guidelines.hover_states: Hover states MUST explicitly define text colors alongside background changes (e.g., hover:bg-amber-500 hover:text-black).
general_ui_ux_guidelines.accessibility: Maintain minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for body text, 3:1 for large display headers and buttons. Never rely on color alone for states.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.animations: Framer motion page transitions, smooth card tilt on hover (transform: rotateX / rotateY), subtle glowing pulse for live preview, reduced motion respect.
